column2:
All Arachnids on the surface of Mahanagar’s central district have been eradicated. The Brain Bug, trapped in its underground lair, now faces its retribution amid the remnants of its minions.

Verhaegen and Keys descend together, knowing this will be the last battle. The fall of the Brain Bug will signify the ultimate triumph over the Arachnid invasion.
Find and capture the Brain Bug
Destroy all Brood Nests to stop the Drone attacks
Clear both Bug Hives to stop the attack waves

// NAME: // Note: Don't translate names starting with #
// ============== /OBJECTIVES/FIND THE BRAIN/TRIGGERS/FIRST ROOM ATTACK/FIRST ROOM ATTACK ==============

column2: The Brain Bug is sending an attack our way. It aims to slow us down!
Then tell the wrinkle-sack he's only delaying the inevitable. We're still comin'!
Let's hunt down and kill this blasted Brain Bug!
Y'know I'd normally agree, but Fed Intel ain't going to be happy if their favorite lab pet arrives to them in pieces. New orders are for capture.
After all this, we're letting that damn thing live?!
Trust me, when it comes to Fed Intel, there's a hell of a lot worse for a Bug than death...
Bravo and Charlie teams are held up in their sectors. Let's help our boys out and catch the Bugs in a pincer!
You got a read on where this slug is cowering yet?
I'm trying...but it's managing to block me out while we're this close.
Then we'll have to do this the old-fashioned way. Let's get to the nearby security center and get on the district cams.
You could have lived today, you ugly sack. I had a friend that tried to protect everyone.
One life or a hundred, it didn't matter to her -- everyone was worth saving all the same.
...but even she wouldn't protect your wrinkly ass.
Command, this is Major Verhaegen. It's over.
Send in cleanup with my exfil. The target didn't make it -- nasty sucker tried to fight back.
Here we go. Not even our cowardly slug friend can hide from Fed Intel's all-seeing eye.
The best protection the Federation has for its citizens is to know exactly what they're doing.
Those...people.... Has it sucked their brains out!?
Brain Bugs are more than just an ugly face.
'Bout time we hunt the bastard down and let Fed Intel give him worse in return.
Water! The Brain Bug is going to flood the whole underground!
A blasted trap! Argh! We need to get out!
No! I can stop this! I can stop the Brain!
I can get us through this... one more time!
We can't risk it Keys! I need to get you and my men out!
This is the Brain's last gambit! I can't let it win now! I... can... stop... this!
You can't always do it all, Keys! Sometimes you pick the battle, or you pick your people.
I'm taking your lead for once and choosing protection! Get! Out!
Got it! Water mains shut down! Ha!
See, Major? I knew I could do this. Now let’s go get that --

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/BRING VERHAEGEN TO DYING KAYLA/KAYLA RUNS BACK ==============

column2: Goddamn it, Keys! Don't die on me!
Come on, kid, don't give up. You're tougher than this!
I want every last Bug in here put down for good.
Send all you want at us, Brain Bug. We'll kill them all the same!
You ain't making it much further, Marauder. Keep this zone locked down instead.
Ah, good to have a Marauder make it in with us!
Not a chance it'll fit anywhere down these tunnels.
No, but it'll sure scare the hell out of our slug friend some more, for now.
The Brain Bug wants us hunted down. Attackers moving through the tunnels, fast!
More Bugs! They ain't about to stop us now!
